source.citation: 'Court House', stereograph, No. 22 [of a Chicago series; the mount names Lovejoy & Foster's 'Chicago and Vicinity'], [1871]. Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division, Stereograph Cards collection, LC-DIG-stereo-1s12325.
